snippet.title: Piscis - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Official launch trailer for Piscis, a small 8-bit arcade-style game where you play as a small fish trying to navigate through an ocean brimming with junk, fishing nets, and hooks. Avoid a barrage of falling obstacles and traverse through colourful level backdrops, alongside an original chiptune soundtrack!

Play now on itch.io!
https://celestigategames.itch.io/piscis

Listen to the Piscis OST!
https://youtu.be/klhYaC4Zu-w
